site_name: Flat A, 701 Seven Sisters Road, Tottenham, London, N15 5LA
description:
Description of the Proposal
The proposal seeks retrospective planning permission for the continued use of the property as a small HMO (Use Class C4) accommodating:
•	A maximum of six occupants
•	A maximum of four households
The internal layout provides appropriate bedroom sizes, shared facilities, and circulation space consistent with HMO standards. The use does not exceed the occupancy thresholds for a small HMO and does not constitute a sui generis use.

Planning History and Licensing Context
The property has been operating as a small HMO for a number of years and has previously been licensed by the London Borough of Haringey. The property has been inspected by the Council’s HMO Licensing Team and found to be suitable for occupation as a licensed HMO, with a draft new renewal if the licence granted subject to standard conditions.
It is acknowledged that planning permission and licensing operate as separate regulatory regimes. This application has therefore been submitted to ensure full compliance with planning requirements.

Planning Balance and Conclusion
This retrospective application seeks to regularise an existing small HMO (Use Class C4) that:
•	Is modest in scale and intensity
•	Meets licensing, safety, and building regulation standards
•	Causes no harm to residential amenity
•	Involves no physical alteration to the exterior of the building
•	Contributes positively to local housing supply
